### Missing null check on parsed config

**Medium Severity**

<!-- DESCRIPTION START -->
`parseConfig` can return `undefined`, but the caller dereferences it without a guard.
<!-- DESCRIPTION END -->

<!-- LOCATIONS START
src/a.ts#L10-L12
LOCATIONS END -->

<!-- devin-review-comment {"id": "BUG_pr-review-job-abc_0001", "file_path": "src/b.ts", "start_line": 30, "end_line": 30, "side": "RIGHT"} -->

🔴 **Off-by-one in the retry loop**

The loop runs one extra attempt when `max` is 0.

**P1** Unhandled promise rejection

`fetchAll()` is not awaited, so a rejection here crashes the process.
This helper looks unused after the refactor; consider removing it.

**High Severity**

A human reviewer whose login merely contains "devin".
